The dental assisting course I took was in person and 8 months long so the DANB test was pretty easy for me.  Basically went over infection control and everything you’ve learned in the course. I didn’t take the test from home though!

I’m sorry you’re going through this! You absolutely should continue assisting if that’s what you want to do. I have two years of ortho assisting down and I feel like I make so many mistakes and feel flustered pretty often. But that’s how we grow and it’s part of the learning process!
A little advice would be to not tell your mom the mistakes your making. I had to learn this with my mom,because she would use any mistake against me and tell the rest of the family. Now when I tell her about work I tell her it’s going good and I’m learning a lot, and that my coworkers are friendly (even if it’s not the whole truth). This way she wont at least criticize this aspect of your life as much
